models.name: Chatterbox Voice
models.blurb: Speak any text in any voice — locally on your Mac.
models.description:
Chatterbox is a production-grade open-source TTS model from Resemble AI that synthesises natural speech from text, and clones any voice from a short audio reference. Type lyrics, dialogue, or narration — get back a WAV file in the voice of your choice. No upload, no per-run charges, works offline. Buy once, generate forever.

Chatterbox is free software (MIT) by Resemble AI — source: https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox
highlights: Text to speech in any voice — speak lyrics, dialogue, or narration
Voice cloning — match any voice from a short audio reference
Runs entirely on Apple Silicon — private, offline, no per-run charges
One-time unlock — generate as many takes as you want

models.name: Whisper Transcription
models.blurb: Transcribe lyrics from any track — instantly, privately, on your Mac.
models.description:
Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition model. Pure BPM uses it to extract lyrics from any track in your library: click the Lyrics button on any track, and Whisper transcribes the vocals directly on your Mac. No audio ever leaves your machine. Included with Pure BPM at no extra cost.

Whisper is free software (MIT) by OpenAI — source: https://github.com/openai/whisper
highlights: Transcribe lyrics from any track — one click from the track detail panel
Runs entirely on-device — no audio sent to any server
Supports speech in 99 languages
Included with Pure BPM — no purchase required

models.name: Semantic Search
models.blurb: Find tracks by feeling, not filename — natural language search powered by LAION-CLAP.
models.description:
LAION-CLAP is an open-source audio-language model that understands what music sounds like, not just what it's called. Type 'melancholy piano late at night' or 'upbeat 90s hip-hop' in the search bar and Pure BPM finds matching tracks using tonal and rhythmic similarity. Analysis runs locally — your library stays private. Included with Pure BPM at no extra cost.

LAION-CLAP is free software (MIT) — source: https://github.com/LAION-AI/CLAP
highlights: Natural language search — describe the sound and find it
Understands mood, genre, instrumentation, and energy
Runs entirely on-device — your library stays private
Included with Pure BPM — no purchase required

models.name: P0 Test Model
models.blurb: Harness walkthrough item — buy, watch it install, then we re-hide it.
models.description: A hidden test item used to verify the marketplace platform end to end (purchase, entitlement, managed install, free reinstall). It is never shown as a card in the app.

models.name: Basic Pitch
models.blurb: Turn any audio into MIDI — on your Mac, in seconds.
models.description: Basic Pitch listens to any track in your library and writes it out as MIDI — chords, melodies and pitch bends included. Built on Spotify's celebrated open transcription research, it runs entirely on your Mac: no upload, no per-run charges, no waiting on a queue. Buy once, extract MIDI forever. The MIDI file lands right next to your audio, ready to drag into any DAW.
highlights: Polyphonic transcription — chords and melodies, with pitch bends
Runs fully on-device on any Mac, CPU only, seconds per track
Extract MIDI from any library track — from the track menu or the Audio Tools panel
One-time unlock — no credits per extraction, works offline

models.name: Matchering
models.blurb: Master your track to sound like your reference — locally, in minutes.
models.description:
Pick any professionally-mastered track you love as the reference, and Matchering reshapes your mix to match it (loudness, frequency balance, peak and stereo width) right on your Mac. The same open-source engine trusted by professional mastering services, running privately in an isolated environment: no upload, no per-run charges, works offline. Buy once, master forever.

Matchering is free software (GPL-3.0) by Sergree. Source: https://github.com/sergree/matchering
highlights: Reference mastering — your track, shaped to a track you love
Matches loudness, EQ balance, peaks and stereo width
Runs fully on-device in an isolated engine — private and offline
One-time unlock — no credits per master
